title: Hezekiah’s Messengers and Assyria’s Threat
reflectionText: Hezekiah’s messengers ask Isaiah to pray for the remnant that is left. Isaiah answers with the command not to fear, and another Assyrian threat follows. How do you hear that answer beside the renewed message, while the account still leaves the king facing the words sent against him?
